comment: Curated kid-friendly schematic library. Each entry is a JSON file under this dir, structured as { footprint: [w, l], height, materials: {block:count}, blocks: [[dx, dy, dz, block_name], ...] }. The bot loads the file and place_one's each entry at (origin + offset). Replaces real .schem/.litematic until we curate proper community schematics — but the contract is identical (origin + offset placements), so swap-in later is one wrapper.

small_house.summary: 5x5 oak cottage with door, roof, and one window

well.summary: 3x3 cobblestone well with water and pillar supports

small_tower.summary: 3x3 cobblestone tower with battlements, 7 blocks tall

campfire_spot.summary: Outdoor sit-down spot — cobblestone fire ring + 4 oak-log seats

treehouse.summary: 5x5 oak treehouse on 4 oak-log stilts (Y+5 platform, Y+8 roof, oak-fence railings)

ice_castle.summary: 7x7 ice castle — blue ice floor, packed ice walls, snow roof, glowstone-topped corner pillars

igloo.summary: 5x5 snow igloo — small dome shelter for emergency night-safety

dirt_shelter.summary: 3x3 emergency dirt shelter — panic button for nightfall (23 dirt blocks, door gap at front)
